seats.notes: Red-white aggro: the red depth (Ashmouth Hounds, Geistflame x2, Harvest Pyre, Furor of the Bitten, Ironsmiths) and white creatures and removal (Smite, Slayer, cheap Sentries) make the 23 playables, since black is too thin. Mountains are the main colour by pips, so 10 Mountain and 7 Plains.

Black-green creature deck with removal (Corpse Lunge, Dead Weight, Tribute to Hunger) and recursion-friendly bodies. Cut Unburial Rites and Night Terrors to reach 23 spells, with 9 Swamp and 8 Forest as the base.

…fliers: Chapel Geists, Stitched Drake, Moon Heron, Lantern Spirit and Gallows Warden carry the evasion, backed by Rebuke, Smite, Feeling of Dread and Midnight Haunting. Left out Thraben Sentry, Dream Twist and Hysterical Blindness for the 23rd-slot fillers; 17 lands with 9 Islands and 8 Plains.

…Wolf), removal (Brimstone Volley, Dead Weight, Sever the Bloodline, Into the Maw of Hell), Galvanic Juggernaut and Scourge as top end, and two Wooden Stakes for Vampire/Zombie-heavy boards. Cut the green cards, Ancient Grudge, Hauberk, and the weaker non-creature spells, and weight mana toward red.

Green-white deck built around cheap creatures, two Rebuke, Smite, Prey Upon and Spidery Grasp, plus Somberwald Spiders and Spider Spawning as flier answers and finishers. Left out the blue, red and black cards and the filler like Full Moon's Rise and Travel Preparations; 9 Forest and 8 Plains.

G/W creature deck with the best white and green creatures, Fiend Hunter, Bonds of Faith and Spidery Grasp as removal and tricks. I cut the off-colour cards, the weak tricks and the equipment, and kept Gavony Township as a land.

UB self-mill deck: the strongest black removal and creatures plus blue fliers and Stitched Drake/Skaab enablers, cut to 23 spells. Cut Lost in the Mist, Manor Skeleton, Ghost Quarter and the weaker Curses to fit 17 lands.

Blue-white deck: blue is the deepest colour, with white for flyers and removal (Claustrophobia, Bonds, Priest). Cut the red, green, and black hedges, Mask of Avacyn's second copy, and the weakest blue spells; 17 lands including Moorland Haunt gives 40 cards.
